page.overview:
Who is Elizabeth S. Braswell?

Captain Elizabeth S. Braswell was a Starfleet officer during the Dominion War.

In 2374, the starship reported Braswell as killed in action. Her name was listed in a casualty list that was displayed in the wardroom of Deep Space 9. (, okudagram)
